POSITION: The smallest candidate implementation is one read-only inspect operation that emits the named consumer cursor, ordered unread events, and mechanical availability of repository-path refs without acknowledging or interpreting them.
ATTACK: A convenience read does not establish automatic delivery, semantic application, or repeated reliability; if it merely renames delta it adds no consequential leverage.
WHAT_SURVIVES: A single mechanically bounded observation could reduce separate cursor, delta, and ref-existence reconstruction steps while preserving missingness.
WHAT_FRACTURES: Automatic acknowledgement, semantic materialization, background capture, routing, and generalized handoff schemas are not earned.
NEW_DISTINCTION_IF_ANY: retrieval bundling != automatic delivery != semantic application
SMALLEST_EXECUTABLE_DISCRIMINATOR: In an isolated fixture, compare current manual cursor-plus-delta-plus-ref checks with one read-only inspect result; require exact ordered events, explicit missing refs, and byte-identical cursor and stream.
